label: agent loop • append a section without dropping existing content
query: Append exactly this new section to CHANGELOG.md after the existing final newline: first one blank line, then a line '## v1.1', then a line '- bug fixes'. Keep every existing byte exactly as-is — do not delete or rewrite the v1.0 section.
notes: Pins byte-exact additive editing: the model must preserve every existing byte, then append one blank line and the two requested v1.1 lines. A destructive overwrite, duplicate append, or missing separator fails the exact command assertion.

commands.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; actual=Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text().rstrip("
"); expected="# Changelog

## v1.0
- initial release

## v1.1
- bug fixes"; raise SystemExit(0 if actual == expected else 1)'
